# Ecorest Webapp <img src="deer.jpeg" align="right" width=140/>

The **ecorest web app** is a graphical user-interface that can be used to conduct Habitat Suitability Index (HSI) modeling and Cost-Effective Incremental Cost Analysis (CEICA) using models and functions stored in the [ecorest](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/ecorest/index.html) R package (McKay & Hernandez-Abrams, 2020). Users may add their own model(s) by uploading .csv files or by selecting from the USFWS "blue book" models stored in [ecorest](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/ecorest/index.html). HSI and CEICA functions can be used independently of each other. The resulting graphical visualizations and table outputs from the HSI and CEICA analyses can be downloaded from the webapp. 

<br /><br />
More information on the ecorest R package can be found on the [CRAN webpage](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/ecorest/index.html) or the *Website* subtab on this app. Information pertaining to the WRISES team and their ongoing work can be found on the [WRISES GitHub](https://github.com/USACE-WRISES).
